items.title: Sakurai's "Avengers of game directors" dinner
items.summary: Smash Bros. creator Masahiro Sakurai posted a photo from a dinner he called an "Avengers-like gathering of game directors": Yoko Taro, Toby Fox, Shinji Mikami, Hideki Kamiya, Suda51, Fumito Ueda, Kazutaka Kodaka, Keiichiro Toyama and Jiro Ishii around one table. It got 461K likes, the most of any post that day. Toby Fox's face was covered with cartoon icons, which made him "the only person I've known to do a reverse face reveal" (31K), and Sakurai later said it was the Game Designers Award group's last meeting.
items.author: @Sora_Sakurai
